flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts + App.tsx (Payment Allow entry without Route; generic /system/parameter page), pages/System/form/ParameterForm; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/parameter/{Parameter,ParameterController}, workflows/notice_creation/core/helpers/{NoticeProcessingHelper,SuspensionBaseHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/ChangeOfProcessingService; ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (PDD), framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper, framework/workflows/paymentcutoff/*, framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, utilities/suspension_helpers/RevivalBaseHelper, application-prod.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties; ocmseserviceapi workflows/parkingfines/{ParkingFinesServiceImplement,ParkingFinesController}; ocmseserviceui pages/Payment/API.ts. thirdpartyapi: not used
note: Sheet status: Built - Has gap. Requirement text is given. The story asks that an officer can set the stages at which payment is accepted and the payment grace period per notice type. Result: there is no configuration page (the 'Payment Allow' entry in System.ts has no Route). The per-notice flag payment_acceptance_allowed does decide whether the public portal accepts payment, but it is set by many paths with hardcoded, non-uniform stage rules (revival list vs the portal's court list), and the open defect OCMS-SR-2026-179 (On Hold) leaves NRO/CSD/CSR notices from CAS unpayable. 'Grace period' does not exist as a concept; the closest is the per-stage parameter PDD, which is editable on the Parameter page but only used for dates on letters and notifications (and its execution is switched off/blocked in the prod properties: sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan, cron.notification.enabled=false, sms.enable=false, email.enableSmtp=false; real server values: cannot verify from repo), and it is not per notice type. Closing payment after the due date exists for court cases only and is not scheduled (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:123 is commented out). Tickets read: OCMS-SR-2026-179, OCMS-DF-2026-180, OCMS-DF-2026-029, OCMS-DF-2026-097, OCMS-DF-2026-173.
recommendation: Limited claim: the per-notice flag decides whether the portal accepts payment, and PDD per stage is editable on the Parameter page. Do not claim a payment-stage configuration page, a grace period per notice type, or automatic closing after the due date for all notices. Follow up OCMS-SR-2026-179 and ask URA to confirm whether PDD = payment grace period

steps.step: Officer opens the configuration page for the stages at which payment is accepted
steps.detail: A 'Payment Allow' menu entry exists in System.ts (System.ts:195-198) but its path is null (System.ts:64) and the System block in App.tsx only registers parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason and schedule-public-holiday (App.tsx:375-500). No page, endpoint or parameter stores a list of payment stages. A synonym search (payment allow, payable stage, allowed payment) in the UI and the APIs found no configuration screen.

steps.step: The system sets the stages at which payment is accepted
steps.detail: There is no single stage list. The per-notice flag payment_acceptance_allowed is set by many paths with hardcoded rules: new V/S/D and foreign-vehicle notices = Y (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:433, 470, 516), type X and AN notices = N (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:142, 407), CPS = Y unless the AN flag is set (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1010-1013), PS with a code in PS_DISABLE_PAYMENT = N (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:350-356), and TS-RED revival uses the list ESERVICE_ALLOWED_PAYMENT_STAGES (NPA to DR3, CPC, CFC, CSD, CSR, COS, COM; SystemConstant.java:109-112, RevivalBaseHelper.java:586-591). The public portal adds its own list for court stages (CPC, CFC, COM, COS, COW, CWM, CWW, CTW, CWT; ParkingFinesServiceImplement.java:33, 374-438) without CSD and CSR, which are in the revival list. All are Java constants; ticket OCMS-SR-2026-179 (On Hold) records that NRO/CSD/CSR notices from CAS get no Y flag because ESERVICE_ALLOWED_PAYMENT_STAGES is only used at TS-RED revival. So stage rules for payment exist, but they are scattered, not uniform, and not configuration.

steps.step: The public portal lets people pay only for notices where payment is allowed
steps.detail: The portal reads the eVON flag: a notice only enters the pay list if paymentAcceptanceAllowed = Y (ParkingFinesController.java:258; ocmseserviceui Payment/API.ts:50-52 sets isSelect only for Y). For court stages the notice/ID search still needs Y and shows E4 when N, while the vehicle number search shows E2 and blocks all court notices (ParkingFinesServiceImplement.java:299-315, 374-438). A payment still being processed (within 300 seconds) blocks a repeat payment (ParkingFinesServiceImplement.java:34, 277-282). Open defect: ticket OCMS-SR-2026-179 (On Hold, Not Started) reports 100 NRO/CSD/CSR notices from CAS with a blank flag that cannot be paid online; the root cause is in how the flag is set, but the result is that notices that should be payable cannot be paid. Because that defect is still open, this step is Sebagian. The payment endpoint (UraPaymentController) does not re-check this flag on the server (grep paymentAcceptance in workflows/urapg found nothing), so enforcement depends on the list that is shown.

steps.step: Officer sets the payment grace period (number of days) through a configuration page
steps.detail: The concept 'grace period' does not exist in the code (grep grace over the six repos found nothing relevant). The closest is Payment Due Days: parameter PDD per stage in ocms_parameter, which the officer can change on the generic System > Parameter page (App.tsx:377-399, ParameterForm.tsx:72-82, ParameterController.java:90-118) and which is read each time it is used, without a cache, to compute the payment deadline on letters (ToppanUploadHelper.java:217-231, default 28 days when missing or invalid) and in eNotification (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1003-1009 for ENA = PDD only; :1088-1090 reminders = POS + PDD; ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180, Closed, confirms ENA without POS). Whether PDD is what URA means by payment grace period: cannot verify from repo. PDD is only used for the date text on letters and notifications; nothing checks this date when the portal accepts a payment. Execution: Toppan letter upload is blocked by sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86), daily letter generation by the scheduler is commented out (addendum), eNotification has cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) and email.enableSmtp=false (:80); the real server values: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The payment grace period can differ for each notice type
steps.detail: The ocms_parameter key is only parameter_id + code (stage) (Parameter.java:28-38); PDD is read per stage without notice type, both in Toppan (ToppanUploadHelper.java:217-221) and in the eNotification query (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1025-1026). One value applies to all notice types. Same finding as OCMS39.3 (days per stage are not per notice type).

steps.step: After the payment deadline passes, payment acceptance is closed automatically
steps.detail: Court cases only: the job picks up notices with court_payment_due_date <= now (OcmsCourtCaseRepository.java:13-19) and sets payment_acceptance_allowed='N' on the intranet VON (PaymentAcceptanceCutoffServiceImpl.java:55, 77-83). The job does not write eVON, which the portal reads (propagation through another sync: cannot verify from repo) and does not apply to non-court stages. The scheduler call is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:123), so it only runs through POST /payment-acceptance-cutoff/execute (PaymentAcceptanceCutoffController.java:28-48). There is no automatic closing based on PDD. Same fit as the similar step in OCMS39.9.
